coverage_note: Executive-branch federal employees under the Federal Service Labor-Management Relations Statute, 5 U.S.C. chapter 71. The Foreign Service, Postal Service and other separately governed workforces are not covered by this row.

governing_statute.value: Federal Service Labor-Management Relations Statute, 5 U.S.C. chapter 71 (sections 7101 to 7135)
governing_statute.quote: Each employee shall have the right to form, join, or assist any labor organization, or to refrain from any such activity, freely and without fear of penalty or reprisal, and each employee shall be protected in the exercise of such right.

labor_board.value: Federal Labor Relations Authority (FLRA); negotiation impasses go to the Federal Service Impasses Panel
labor_board.quote: The Federal Labor Relations Authority is composed of three members, not more than 2 of whom may be adherents of the same political party.

ulp_limitation_period.value: Six months from the alleged unfair labor practice to the filing of the charge with the FLRA, with a tolling exception in 7118(a)(4)(B)
ulp_limitation_period.quote: no complaint shall be issued based on any alleged unfair labor practice which occurred more than 6 months before the filing of the charge with the Authority.

who_may_bargain.value: Individuals employed in a covered executive agency, minus the statute's exclusions. The President may exclude agencies or subdivisions with national-security functions, and Executive Order 14251 (March 27, 2025) excluded a long list of them.
who_may_bargain.quote: (2) "employee" means an individual— (A) employed in an agency; or (B) whose employment in an agency has ceased because of any unfair labor practice under section 7116 of this title

impasse_procedure.value: Mediation through the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service; if that fails, either party may go to the Federal Service Impasses Panel, or the parties may agree to binding arbitration with Panel approval
impasse_procedure.quote: (b) If voluntary arrangements, including the services of the Federal Mediation and Conciliation Service or any other third-party mediation, fail to resolve a negotiation impasse— (1) either party may request the Federal Service Impasses Panel to consider the matter, or (2) the parties may agree to adopt a procedure for binding arbitration of the negotiation impasse

strike_legality.value: Prohibited: calling, joining or condoning a strike, work stoppage or slowdown is an unfair labor practice for a labor organization
strike_legality.quote: (7)(A) to call, or participate in, a strike, work stoppage, or slowdown, or picketing of an agency in a labor-management dispute if such picketing interferes with an agency's operations

agency_fee_status.value: None. Dues are deducted only on an employee's written assignment, and the statute protects the right to refrain from joining.
agency_fee_status.quote: If an agency has received from an employee in an appropriate unit a written assignment which authorizes the agency to deduct from the pay of the employee amounts for the payment of regular and periodic dues of the exclusive representative of the unit, the agency shall honor the assignment

dfr_forum.value: FLRA. The duty to represent all unit employees is in 7114(a)(1), and a union's failure to comply with the chapter is an unfair labor practice under 7116(b)(8), charged at the FLRA.
dfr_forum.quote: It is responsible for representing the interests of all employees in the unit without discrimination and without regard to labor organization membership.
